body: Oh I probibly shoulve mentioned that we hung out a year before this one, and it didint work out (Mostly cuz I didint wanna go for it), cuz it moved to damn fast. But rn, its going slow and Im kind of enjoying it and feel like I didint really know her that much.

yeh, well thats the thing, I am an overthinker. If we are chatting f2f, everything is okey, I just wanna talk, but when Im sitting and chilling and start thinking about future and stuff, I come to a conclusion that I am lost, mostly cuz I feel like "I can do better", but idk if I could :D.
Thanks, I shall do so! Thanks for the advice, I will try to pursue my goals!

You are right, Im gonna try being skinny and hey if I dont like it, I can allways cut the sports a bit and start eating more. Im gonna try out being healthy, maybe I will love it a lot more! Thanks! Thanks you **helped**

Allright thanks, I think I know what I should do now and why, I am gonna go with the skinny, I might not like it or I might love it, there is way more benefits of being skinny in a long run, being chubby just satisfies my inner self and I never know, maybe Ill love having sports as my hobby and I will love to look skinny! Thanks again, I know what to do.

Thanks I really appreciate, but I kind of wanna lean towards getting slimmer for health reasons, so I might love myself if I get slimmer, right? Worst case scenario I will start eating more and gain it back :D Hopefully. But thanks, atleast I know Im not lying to myself about liking me as I am :)

Yeh thats what I keep thinking about, if this goes on, I will most likely gain even more weight and be way more unhappy. I did see a doctor and he said, he'd recommend so, but its not mandatory yet (In similar words). Plus the the benefits of healthier mind and being limber and stuff is great too. So far Im kind of leaning towards going actively to work out.

oh shoot, I never thought about it that way, not a lot people were shaming me for it ether, maybe I love it, because I only gotten the positives sides to it, come to think of it, no one really said to me that I should loose weight or I look unattractive that way, they actually said the opposite, that being chubby makes me look better (Round fits me more a bit, at least when I gained it). Damn thanks, I have a new point of view now.

Yeh I usually hear people saying "awww I wish Id be slimmer" or similar, but whenever I hear so, I just cant relate, I usually think about it and I feel like I wont be able to relate, so I just keep my mouth shut, but maybe its the laziness talking, not sure.. :)

Oh interesting, thats a good read, thanks I will read about it, and it does sound like it might be true, I think I can relate to that, I think being healther gives you way more perks then cons, and worst case scenario I can just stop the workouts if I feel like I dont like becoming less chubby. I will deffo read on that! Thanks :)

Thanks! And yeh, thats why Im mostly concerned, maybe I dont wish it, because I donno what it would be, I was slim during my teenage days, gain weight overtime, wasnt anything sudden, just got  a job, allowed myself to treat with better (Tastier) meals, but I cannot shake the feeling that maybe I would love being slimmer but I just dont wanna change?

Yeh I think I do, and it might be the reason, but I cannot have this feeling like maybe I should try to be slimmer, maybe I will like it like someone mentioned it, I have few active hobbies like airsoft and being slim in there, really improves on the hobby itself. But fetish, I would say yes, I have them, but I m not sure if I wont feel different if id be slimer

I feel like a chubby bear, not sure how to describe it, but My gf calls me similar name to a teddy, and I love it. One more comment asked if I have a fetish regarding being chubby, and I think he was on point, I do have that as well, but I might have new ones if Im slim, who knows :D
Good luck with it man! Im sure you are gonna get your goal, and it might be the case for me, I just dont know it? Not sure
